note: Test reply: December, snow, unpaid camp, heavy roads, refugees, a battle account he was not at. Illustrative. The ground after the battle can be ridden over.

remarks: The men in camp have not been paid since October; two have gone over the hill this week.
Count Starhemberg now speaks against you in the Conference.

hidden.chronicle: Test chronicle: December; an affair near Mollwitz; refugees on the road.

decisions.knows: The Emperor is dead; Vienna is in mourning and short of money.
decisions.decides: Keeps his counsel and orders the regiments readied, quietly.

reports.title: An affair near Mollwitz
reports.text: The garrison troops met a Prussian column on the open ground by Mollwitz and fell back in order after an hour’s firing. The account of the ground is enclosed.

reports.title: Families on the Silesian road
reports.text: Carts and families from the Silesian villages are on the road to Vienna; the gates are crowded.
reports.source: what your steward saw at the gate

changes.title: Snow on the Silesian road
changes.briefing: December. The camp is unpaid, the roads are heavy and families are on the road from Silesia.

aftermath.note: The garrison troops lie where the column caught them by the Mollwitz road.
